en: The first-attempt evidence failure at e0316 remains unscored. The original post-run audit compared a preparatory timestamp against the 85 s threshold. A separately frozen audit used the recorded owned-job termination call for unstarted slots and kept the native solver, charging, and prescribed limits unchanged. M/EAX: 198 pairs, 159/2/37 shorter/tied/longer, map-weighted mean +24030.25 ppm with 95% percentile interval [+6763.64, +50836.32]. K/EAX: 198 pairs, 164/3/31 shorter/tied/longer, map-weighted mean +24008.70 ppm with 95% percentile interval [+6742.41, +50802.43]. The separate EAX report includes delivery, missing pairs and multiplicity.
